title: poterium polygamum f. lasiocarpum
intro: Poterium polygamum f. lasiocarpum, commonly known as Bitter Poterium, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Asia, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its diverse health benefits. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Bitter Poterium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
